pages.text: After a decade of peace, no notable flowers had joined the Botanist Flora. Then, one day, a space time super nova struck the realm of Botanists!$(br2)The mystical flowers that dominated the overworld surface have been $(l:botania:petals)scattered elsewhere/$. Some of them even transformed into a different form of themselves! Others have $(bold)Evolved/$, gaining new powers.

Many anomilies that have resulted from the super nova have been documented in other entries. $(br2)See if you can reunite the mystical flowers of all colors! $(br2)$(bold)Bonus:/$ See if you can automate all of them!
